title: Add betterado_release_folder resource for organizing Azure DevOps release definitions
essence: A new Terraform resource betterado_release_folder is now available, enabling practitioners to create, update, and delete release-definition folders in Azure DevOps via the Release REST API. Before this change there was no Terraform-managed way to organise release definitions into folders; after it, the full CRUD lifecycle is covered with gomock-backed unit tests and import support.
